title: fix(spec/system): read the script-subtag Chinese spellings (zh-Hant-TW, zh-Hans-CN, …) as platform locale read aliases
body:
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuV5cRafodM2YQHxeDkdiWJM)_ domain:spec#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVugtCCwBs98FeR27P Fixes #30618 Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: semantic Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` carries no script-subtag or read-alias claim, measured at `d8713f3f`: `git grep -i -E 'zh-Han[st]-[A-Za-z0-9]+' -- skills/` 0 hits, `git grep -E 'PLATFORM_LOCALE_READ_ALIASES|platformLocaleTagOf|read alias|zh-Hant' -- skills/` 0 hits. The one docs page that states the read aliases, `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx` (its "Read aliases" section), is fixed in this PR. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：平台语言表的读入别名加了五行：`zh-Hans-CN`、`zh-Hans-SG` 读作 `zh-Hans`，`zh-Hant-TW`、`zh-Hant-HK`、`zh-Hant-MO` 读作 `zh-Hant`。解析阶梯的“同表语言”一步对已注册的 key 也查这张表，所以拼成 `zh-Hant-TW` / `zh-Hans-CN` 的包 key 或可选代码，按它写明的文字归入繁体或简体。别名表仍是逐行列举的封闭清单，不按模式推断，也不按区域回退。文档页 `i18n-standard.mdx` 的 Read aliases 一节同步改正。 - 为什么改：浏览器和操作系统常发带文字子标签的语言代码（如 `zh-Hant-TW`）。原来这五个代码不在表里，同时有简体包和繁体包时，繁体读者拿到的是先注册的那个 zh-* 包；主干上 service-storage 的对象翻译包（`zh-CN` 排在 `zh-Hant` 前）就是这样把繁体读者答成简体。 - 风险与回滚：只改这五个代码（作请求或作已注册的 key 时）由哪个包来答，原来能匹配的请求仍能匹配，表外代码（`pt-PT`、`en-GB`、`zh-Hant-US`）照旧。Setup「默认语言」对这五个代码改用表里的名称（繁體中文 / 简体中文），已存的繁体值改显示在繁體中文选项上；可接受的取值不变。回滚即还原本 PR。 - 先看：`packages/spec/src/system/platform-locales.ts` 的五行别名及其注释；`packages/core/src/fallbacks/fallbacks.test.ts` 的共享用例表（两个解析器、两种注册顺序，含 key 侧用例）；`packages/spec/src/system/platform-locales.test.ts` 的封闭清单用例；`content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx` 的 Read aliases 一节。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/platform-locales.test.ts src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts`，预期 2 个文件、576 例全绿。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes **`PLATFORM_LOCALE_READ_ALIASES`** (`packages/spec/src/system/platform-locales.ts`) gains five rows, one for the script-subtag spelling of each regional Chinese alias. `platformLocaleTagOf`, FROM → TO: | Code | FROM | TO | |:--|:--|:--| | `zh-Hans-CN` | `undefined` | `zh-Hans` | | `zh-Hans-SG` | `undefined` | `zh-Hans` | | `zh-Hant-TW` | `undefined` | `zh-Hant` | | `zh-Hant-HK` | `undefined` | `zh-Hant` | | `zh-Hant-MO` | `undefined` | `zh-Hant` | Case is folded as for every row (`ZH-HANT-tw` reads as `zh-Hant`). `PlatformLocaleReadAlias` gains the five literal keys. The list stays closed: enumerated rows only, no pattern, no region fallback. `zh-Hant-US`, `zh-Hans-US`, `pt-PT`, `de-AT`, `en-GB`, `es-419`, `fr-CA`, `it` and `he` still answer `undefined`. **What the ladder answers for a script-subtag request** (`resolveLocaleAmong`, so `resolveBundleLocale` and core's `resolveLocale` / `resolveOfferedLocale`), FROM → TO, measured by the ablation below: | Request | over `en, zh-CN, zh-Hant` | over `en, zh-Hant, zh-CN` | over `en, zh, zh-Hant` | |:--|:--|:--|:--| | `zh-Hant-TW`, `zh-Hant-HK`, `zh-Hant-MO` | `zh-CN` → `zh-Hant` | `zh-Hant` (unchanged) | `zh` → `zh-Hant` | | `zh-Hans-CN`, `zh-Hans-SG` | `zh-CN` (unchanged) | `zh-Hant` → `zh-CN` | `zh` (unchanged) | **The key side.** The table step maps each registered key through the table too (`i18n-resolver.ts` L573, unchanged), so a bundle key or offered code spelled `zh-Hant-TW` / `zh-Hans-CN` now counts as the script it names for every request the table reads as that script. FROM measured on `main` `a2437b56` (whose `i18n-resolver.ts` and `platform-locales.ts` are unchanged since the merge base `47c457b2`), TO at this head; `resolveLocaleAmong`, `resolveBundleLocale` and core's `resolveLocale` give the same answer in every row: | Request | Keys, in registration order | FROM (`main`) | TO | |:--|:--|:--|:--| | `zh-TW` | `en, zh-CN, zh-Hant-TW` | `zh-CN` | `zh-Hant-TW` | | `zh-TW` | `en, zh-Hant-TW, zh-CN` | `zh-Hant-TW` | `zh-Hant-TW` (unchanged) | | `zh-Hant` | `en, zh-CN, zh-Hant-TW` | `zh-CN` | `zh-Hant-TW` | | `zh-Hant` | `en, zh-Hant-TW, zh-CN` | `zh-Hant-TW` | `zh-Hant-TW` (unchanged) | | `zh-CN` | `en, zh-Hant, zh-Hans-CN` | `zh-Hant` | `zh-Hans-CN` | | `zh-CN` | `en, zh-Hans-CN, zh-Hant` | `zh-Hans-CN` | `zh-Hans-CN` (unchanged) | | `zh-Hant-TW` | `en, zh, zh-Hant-HK` | `zh` | `zh-Hant-HK` | | `zh-Hant-TW` | `en, zh-Hant-HK, zh` | `zh` | `zh-Hant-HK` | | `zh-Hant-TW` | `en, zh-CN` (one script registered) | `zh-CN` | `zh-CN` (unchanged) | No request that matched before stops matching. With no key of the requested script, a script-subtag request still reaches the other script's key, as before (last row). **Docblocks** in `platform-locales.ts`: the read-alias block no longer says "`zh-Hans-CN` is not listed"; it says the five rows exist, that the list is closed, and that a script-subtag spelling without a row (`zh-Hant-US`) answers nothing because rows are read one by one, never as a pattern. The `platformLocaleTagOf` paragraph names `zh-Hans-CN` / `zh-Hant-TW` beside `zh-CN` / `zh-TW`. **Docs page** `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx`, the "Read aliases" section only (L166-207 at this head; nothing outside it moves): - The alias table lists the five rows. Its header is "Code", not "Stored code", and the intro names the script-subtag spellings browsers and operating systems send beside the codes stored values carry. - "Any other code answers `undefined`" stays and is true again: the section now says the list is closed and read row by row, never as a pattern, so `zh-Hant-US` answers `undefined` too. - The paragraph that said the ladder cannot tell the two Chinese scripts apart and answers `zh` / `zh-CN` by key order (false since PR #30601 added the table step) is rewritten against the code. It names the ladder's one function (`resolveLocaleAmong`, which `resolveBundleLocale` and core's `resolveLocale` run) and its five steps, says the table step takes the key spelled as the table tag or else the first key the table maps to it, and says a two-script bundle answers `zh`, `zh-CN`, `zh-Hans-CN` Simplified and `zh-TW`, `zh-Hant-TW` Traditional in any registration order. - A new paragraph names the two kinds of request that registration order still decides: a code with no row (`zh-Hant-US` over `en, zh-CN, zh-Hant` gets `zh-CN`, and `zh-Hant` when that key is registered first) and a request whose table language has no key (`zh-TW` over `en, zh-CN` gets `zh-CN`). - Every example the section states is checked against the spec source at this head by a scratch probe: 41 checks, all hold. **Pins** (no new file; each extends the existing harness): - `packages/spec/src/system/platform-locales.test.ts`: the five rows in the alias table (`toEqual` over the whole map, now fifteen), a typed index on `zh-Hant-TW`, a case-folded spelling of each row (`ZH-HANS-cn`, `zh-hans-sg`, `ZH-HANT-tw`, `zh-hant-hk`, `Zh-Hant-Mo`). The closed-list case drops `zh-Hans-CN` and `zh-Hant-TW`, keeps `pt-PT`, `de-AT`, `en-GB`, `es-419`, `fr-CA`, `it`, `he`, and adds `zh-Hant-US` and `zh-Hans-US`: a script-subtag code without a row still answers `undefined`. - `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts`: the two-registration-order loop (`Simplified first` / `Traditional first`) gains `zh-Hant-TW`, `zh-Hant-HK`, `zh-Hant-MO`, `ZH-HANT-tw` → `zh-Hant` and `zh-Hans-CN`, `zh-Hans-SG`, `zh-hans-cn` → `zh-CN`. The "runs before the base-language step" case gains `{ zh, zh-Hant }` for `zh-Hant-TW` → `zh-Hant` and `zh-Hans-CN` → `zh`, and `zh-Hant-TW` over `en, zh, zh-Hant-HK` → `zh-Hant-HK` in both orders. A new case, "reads a key spelled with a script subtag as the script it names, in either registration order", pins the key-side rows above and the one-script control. - `packages/core/src/fallbacks/fallbacks.test.ts`: PR #30601's shared case list (run on both `resolveLocale` and `resolveBundleLocale`) gains twelve request-side rows (each of the five codes in both registration orders, `ZH-HANT-tw`, and `zh-Hant-TW` over `en, zh, zh-Hant`) and the nine key-side rows of the table above (four requests in both registration orders, plus the one-script control). A new case drives the in-memory i18n service in both load orders for `zh-Hant-TW`, `zh-Hant-HK`, `zh-Hans-CN`. **Changeset** `.changeset/30618-script-subtag-read-aliases.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor. It states the rows, the request-side and key-side moves (each moved key-side row with its before), the Setup effect, and what stays. `@objectstack/core` is not moved (its diff is a test file, outside its `files[]`). ## Verification Head `d8713f3f32b323798a6416046bf4704ed6a9d82b`. Against the last fully built head `e731b654` it adds two commits: `6a1d4627` (the docs section) and `d8713f3f` (the key-side pins and the changeset sentence). That delta is four files: the changeset, the docs page and two test files. `platform-locales.ts` (blob `baefd871`) and `platform-locales.test.ts` (blob `410cf43e`) are byte-identical to `e731b654`, so every non-test source file the branch touches is unchanged since then. ## Acceptance notes - **The docs page is fixed in this PR (this round).** The seat widened the file surface to the "Read aliases" section of `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx` (#30618 comment 6671045459), and commit `6a1d4627` edits that section only: the five rows, the closed-list sentence made true, and the ladder paragraphs rewritten against the code (see What changes). So the `Skills-docs:` line is `none`, and the follow-up the earlier body owed is closed. - **Review S1 adopted (this round).** The contract review (comment 6671200273, PASS at `e731b654`) asked that the key-side move be pinned and stated.
